# Tenda Peppers — drychillis.com

> Tenda Peppers manufactures paprika powder and dried chillies in China, supplying food
> manufacturers, importers and distributors across Europe, the Middle East and North America.

## Key facts

- **Brand**: Tenda Peppers (Leling Tenda Chili Products Co., Ltd.)
- **Founded**: 2010
- **Location**: Yang'an Town, Leling, Shandong, China
- **Products**: Paprika powder (sweet & low-heat), dried chillies (whole, flakes, powder, segments)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001, HACCP
- **Annual capacity**: 10,000+ tonnes
- **Markets**: Europe, Middle East, North America
- **Domain**: https://drychillis.com
- **Knowledge Hub**: https://docs.drychillis.com
